Your World. Your Rules. Your Brookhaven.
PLAY

EVERYONE IS WELCOME IN BROOKHAVEN
Brookhaven is a town built by everyone in it. A place where everyone belongs. A place for community, discovery, and curiosity.
Create Your World.
Houses, shops, a school, a hospital, the works. Run a cafe today, a fire station tomorrow. Pick where you live. Drive any car you want. It's all yours.
Play with New and Old Friends.
There are millions of players a day in Brookhaven. Some are throwing birthday parties. Some are hanging out at the fountain. Your friends are probably already here.
Explore and Discover.
Brookhaven has a secret. People have been finding pieces of it for years. Strange doors. Glowing rooms. Stuff that wasn't there yesterday. Solve Brookhaven mysteries.
WELCOME TO BROOKHAVEN!
Create, discover, role play and explore in Brookhaven- it's your world!
PLAY NOW
DISCOVER
Three of the hottest spots in Brookhaven.
BROOKHAVEN HIGH SCHOOL
Where everyone meets everyone. The class is optional. The drama isn't.
JETT'S JUNGLE NUGGETS
Just opened. Cook your own jungle nuggets. Crank the jukebox.
Listen to the new record
.
BIG FRANK'S MOTORS
Drive home in something fast. Come back when you're tired of it.

&

🐾 Pet Simulator 99!
September 12, 2026
Coin Craft!
🕹️ CRAFT 1 of 3,000 TITANICS! 🎉 Quest for NEON loot! 🎁 Trade Invaders for GIFTS! 🚀 Spend Tokens on BOOSTS! 👾 3 new minigames, merchants, and zones! ⚔️ Top the LEAGUE or go SOLO!
Coin Craft
Uh oh, the
Coin Arcade
is
glitching
out!
CRAFT
a
TITANIC
, win them
hourly
, and chase the
GARGANTUAN
!
Featuring
🔨 Crafting Machine
Fire up the brand-new
Crafting Machine
!
Turn your
Arcade Pets
,
Coins
, and
Gifts
into rarer pets!
Craft the
HUGE Anaglyph Monkey
, then combine
10
for a
TITANIC
!
Only
3,000 TITANIC Arcade Angelus
can be crafted!
Fresh
recipes
roll in every
3 hours
.
📜 Arcade Quest
Take on the
Arcade Quest
, 8 goals long!
Hatch
eggs
, play
minigames
, and beat
Boss Chests
to clear it!
Earn
Arcade Tickets
and
Arcade Boosts
along the way!
🎁 Gift Machine
Cash in your haul at the new
Gift Machine
!
Trade
10 Arcade Invaders
for an
Arcade Gift
!
Your pets find
Arcade Invaders
while they farm the zones.
Crack each one open for
boosts
,
enchants
, and
potions
!
🚀 Boost Machine
Power up at the new
Boost Machine
!
Spend
Arcade Tokens
on
Coin
,
XP
, and
Luck
boost time!
Bank up to
6 hours
of each boost.
👾 New Minigames
Every new zone packs its own
minigame
!
Merge pets in
Fruit Tiles
and hop across roads in
Crossy Pets
!
Every run earns
Arcade Tickets
for the
Raffle
.
Plus one more to discover!
Limited Pets
💪 Gargantuan Returns
Missed the
GARGANTUAN RGB Angelus
? It's back!
Crack the toughest
Boss Chests
for your shot at it!
The rarest pet in the whole event!
🔥 Limited Titanic Pets
Check out these sweet
TITANIC
pets!
Titanic Arcade Angelus
- Craft it at the Crafting Machine
Titanic Techno Cat
- Crack top-level Boss Chests
Titanic Highlighter Dragon
- Win the hourly Arcade Raffle
Titanic Blurred Dominus
- Top the Leaderboard
Titanic Anaglyph Agony
- Top the League
⭐ Limited Huge Pets
A wave of new
HUGE
pets have arrived!
Huge Anaglyph Monkey
- Craft it at the Crafting Machine
Huge Error Axolotl
- Crack the Boss Chest
Huge Error Dog
- Found by your pets in the Arcade Zones
Huge Arcade Fox
- Win the hourly Arcade Raffle
Huge Anaglyph Sloth
- Top the Leaderboard
Huge Blurred Bear
- Top the League
🐾 More Pets
Hatch
9
more
Arcade Pets
!
The new best is the
Techno Cat
!
Look out for the
Anaglyph Agony
and
Blurred Dominus
!
🐣 More Eggs
5
new
Arcade Eggs
just hit the shelves!
Only the
3
newest Merchants carry them.
Hunt
Golden
,
Rainbow
, and
Shiny
versions of every new pet!
Event
🎟️ Raffle Refresh
The
Arcade Raffle
just restocked its prizes!
Every hour,
500
players win the
HUGE Arcade Fox
!
And
5
lucky winners grab the
TITANIC Highlighter Dragon
!
Your
tickets
count toward
both
prizes every draw.
👑 Boss Chest
Your
Boss Chest
is stuffed with new prizes!
Crack it for the
HUGE Error Axolotl
and
TITANIC Techno Cat
!
Max-level chests burst with
MASSIVE
piles of
coins
!
💰 Claim All
Hit the new
Claim All
button in the
hub
!
It collects every zone's
coins
,
Tokens
, and
loot
in one tap.
Your pets might even find the
HUGE Error Dog
!
🕹️ More Zones
3
new zones just
glitched
into the arcade!
Push past
Star Stage
into
Hex Hollow
and
Diamond Divide
!
Then brave
Error End
, where everything
bugs out
!
Each zone pays
WAY
more than the last!
How FAR can your pets go?
🥚 More Merchants
3
more
Egg Merchants
just set up shop!
Unlock them with
Arcade Coins
to hatch the
best
pets.
⬆️ More Upgrades
9
new upgrade tracks join the lineup!
Each new zone gets
Coin Payout
,
Pet Slots
, and
Loot Tray
.
That's
28
tracks to max out with
Arcade Tokens
!
⚡ Tier III Boosts
Tier III Arcade Boosts
are the strongest yet!
Arcade Coin Boost III
- 5x Arcade Coins for 30 minutes
Arcade XP Boost III
- 5x pet XP for 30 minutes
Arcade Luck Boost III
- +100% Merchant luck for 30 minutes
Find them in top-level
Boss Chests
and the
packs
.
🌃 Neon Hoverboard & Booth
Light up the arcade with the
Neon Hoverboard
and
Neon Booth
!
Finish the
Arcade Quest
to claim them both!
The quest is the
ONLY
way to get them.
Open all night!
Contests
🥇 Arcade League
Squad up in the
2026 Arcade League
!
Grab
3
friends and crack
Boss Chests
together!
Bigger, shinier chests score
WAY
more points!
No
clan
needed, just your
squad
!
#1 Place:
Gargantuan RGB Angelus
#2-3 Place:
Rainbow Shiny Titanic Anaglyph Agony
#4-10 Place:
Rainbow Titanic Anaglyph Agony
#11-25 Place:
Golden Titanic Anaglyph Agony
#26-100 Place:
Titanic Anaglyph Agony
#101-500 Place:
Rainbow Huge Blurred Bear
#501-2,000 Place:
Golden Huge Blurred Bear
#2,001-5,000 Place:
Huge Blurred Bear
Every member
in your squad gets the prize!
🏆 Arcade Leaderboard
Hatch from the
Merchants
to climb a fresh
leaderboard
!
The
rarer
the pet, the
bigger
your score!
#1-3 Place:
Rainbow Shiny Titanic Blurred Dominus
#4-10 Place:
Golden Shiny Titanic Blurred Dominus
#11-100 Place:
Rainbow Titanic Blurred Dominus
#101-250 Place:
Shiny Titanic Blurred Dominus
#251-500 Place:
Golden Titanic Blurred Dominus
#501-1,000 Place:
Titanic Blurred Dominus
#1,001-10,000 Place:
Huge Anaglyph Sloth
Good luck!
Exclusive
😈 Arcade Corrupt Egg
Skip the grind with the
Arcade Corrupt Egg
!
Every hatch is one of the
top Arcade Pets
, or better!
Push your luck for the
HUGE Cyborg Mortuus
or
TITANIC Metal Skull
!
Every
TITANIC
hatch brings a
Techno Cat
along too!
Limited-time only - don't miss your chance!
📦 Zigzag Pack
Stock up with the brand-new
Zigzag Pack
!
Packed with
7 Exclusive Eggs
and
5 Arcade Corrupt Eggs
!
Plus
300 Arcade Tickets
,
25 Tier III Boosts
, and
Mega Chests
!
Limited-time only!
🌈 Forever Pack
Keep the rewards rolling with the
Forever Pack
!
Featuring the brand-new
HUGE Anaglyph Agony
!
And, of course, the
GARGANTUAN Lucky Block Shark
and
TITANIC Ultra Butterfly
!
Stocked with
Arcade Corrupt Eggs
,
Diamonds
,
Arcade Tickets
, and
Tier III Boosts
!
Limited-time only - grab it while you can!
Changes
📋 Boss Chest Slots
Your
Boss Chest
now has its own row in
Manage Pets
!
Swap all
4
boss pets without walking to the chest.
It even shows your total
boss damage
!
🎮 Gamepad Controls
Every minigame now plays great on a
controller
!
Press
B
any time to quit a run.
🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed mobile taps falling through minigames onto the
pet hotbar
.
Fixed
touch
controls when using more than one finger.
Made the
touch D-pads
bigger and easier to hit.
KEEP CRAFTING!
~ Preston & PS99 Dev Team
